description: This file defines the PHP client class for interacting with the Amazon WorkMail Message Flow service within the AWS SDK. It extends the AwsClient class and includes method annotations for operations related to raw message content.

classes.name: WorkMailMessageFlowClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon WorkMail Message Flow API, providing methods for retrieving and uploading raw message content.

methods.name: getRawMessageContent
methods.description: Retrieves the raw message content of an email message.

methods.name: getRawMessageContentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the raw message content of an email message.

methods.name: putRawMessageContent
methods.description: Uploads raw message content to the specified email message.

methods.name: putRawMessageContentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously uploads raw message content to the specified email message.
